mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and hepatotoxic; tobramycin causes dose-dependent renal injury while pyrazinamide causes hepatotoxicity and hyperuricemia, and concurrent use increases risk of organ toxicity.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) and hepatic function (LFTs, uric acid) regularly; adjust tobramycin dosing based on renal clearance; consider alternative TB regimen if possible.
